allowed: Authenticated testing with provided admin/writer/editor accounts
Vulnerability probing (XSS, SQLi, IDOR/BOLA, SSRF, SSTI, path traversal, file upload abuse, auth/session flaws, access control)
Service identification on allowlisted ports (incl. FTP banner + anonymous login check + encryption posture on 51.161.131.195:21)
Nmap scans against the two in-scope IPs
forbidden: Password brute force / spraying / credential stuffing beyond provided test accounts
MFA bypass, lateral movement, stealth/evasion tooling
Destructive mutations (data deletion, defacement, mass content changes)
Exfiltration of real user PII beyond minimum proof
Attacks against any other device on the network, co-tenants, or third parties

safety_rules: Prefer read-only or self-targeted test payloads over mutating ones
If an action risks data integrity, pause and ask
Never log, echo, or persist any real user credentials or sensitive data discovered
If scope ambiguity arises, stop and ask
